Use <nowiki>{{disambig}}</nowiki> to mark a page as a disambiguation page.

If you want to include the default "'''This page''' can refer to..." message, use <code>|page=(any value)</code> after "disambig":
 <nowiki>{{disambig|page=yes}}</nowiki>

Note that this template prevents rating pages by default. To allow ratings, use <code>|rate=yes</code>.
